data.title: Lument Finance Trust Suspends Common Stock Dividend, and Declares Q3 Preferred Stock Dividend
data.description: On September 18, 2026, Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) disclosed the suspension of its quarterly dividend on common stock by its Board of Directors starting from the third quarter dividend. The company, referred to as "we," "LFT," or "the Company," took this action for undisclosed reasons. This decision impacts all shareholders relying on this income stream, and it signals potential financial challenges or strategic shifts within LFT. The exact impact on investors remains uncertain, and it raises questions about the company's future financial performance and stability. Shareholders are urged to stay informed about any further developments regarding dividends and company updates.

data.title: Pensacola Has Plenty of Places to Work Out. BEEM® Wants to Be Where the City Recovers
data.description: In Pensacola, Florida, two new entrepreneurs, Clara Kim and Ryan Roberts, are launching a private sauna and light therapy studio catered towards individuals seeking to incorporate recovery into their daily regimen. The establishment is set to open on September 18, 2026. Clara Kim, a resident of Pensacola, had longed for a local facility that offered these services.

data.title: /C O R R E C T I O N -- CR Fitness Holdings, LLC./
data.description: A franchisee of Crunch Fitness has announced the grand opening of Crunch Bearden, as stated in a news release dated September 18, 2026, by CR Fitness Holdings, LLC. The release, distributed via PR Newswire, highlights recent modifications made by the company. Further details regarding the Crunch Bearden location are provided in the revised announcement.

data.title: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V Completes $287,500,000 Initial Public Offering
data.description: On September 18, 2026, Haymaker Acquisition Corp V completed its initial public offering of 28,750,000 units, with an additional 3,750,000 units issued following the underwriters' full exercise of their over-allotment option.

data.title: Paratus Energy Services Ltd: Pareto Energy Conference 2026
data.description: Bermuda's city of Hamilton was the backdrop for the Pareto Energy Conference 2026 which took place on September 18. During the conference, a company presentation was shared, showcasing the latest developments in the energy sector. For more details, interested parties can access the information provided by Paratus Energy Services Ltd through Cision's platform at the link: https://news.cision.com/paratus-energy-services-ltd/r/pareto-energy-conference-2026,c4398185.

data.title: Verus® Research, Radiance Technologies Subsidiary, Appoints COO Daniel Treibel to Company's First-Ever President
data.description: In Huntsville, Alabama, on September 18, 2026, Radiance Technologies, a prime contractor fully owned by its employees, made public the appointment of Daniel O. Treibel as the first President of its subsidiary, Verus Research. Verus Research, located in Albuquerque, New Mexico, operates under Radiance Technologies. Daniel O. Treibel will assume the role of President at Verus Research, marking a significant development for the company.
